patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff did not apply, so the fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative 22094-fix image. That fixed build rejects the original 5225-vs-64 overlay/alpha mismatch before any downstream alpha use and only reaches downstream alpha consumption on the overlay_canvas_64 perturbation where the alpha plane width matches the image width.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before colorspace conversion proceeds with a transferred alpha plane, it must establish that `input->get_width(heif_channel_Alpha) == input->get_width()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original treats alpha-channel presence as sufficient and carries a 64-pixel alpha plane into a 5225-pixel overlay image. The fixed image rejects that mismatched width at the guard and only reaches downstream alpha use on the overlay_canvas_64 perturbation where the alpha plane width matches the image width.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable original: alpha_width_guard.alpha_width=64 while alpha_width_guard.image_width=5225 and alpha_read_sink executes. Fixed original: the same protected event is absent with alpha_width_guard.alpha_width=64 and alpha_width_guard.image_width=5225. Fixed overlay_canvas_64 perturbation: alpha_width_guard.alpha_width == alpha_width_guard.image_width == 64 and alpha_read_sink executes.

nodes.state: At the sanitizer sink, the conversion loop uses the full image width even though the transferred alpha plane is only 64 pixels wide, so the alpha read runs past the plane row.

edges.relation: The same transferred alpha-plane width observed at the missing guard site is the alpha-plane width later consumed by the downstream conversion stage.
